people.name: William Theodore de Bary
people.field: Sinologist and scholar of East Asian philosophy

relations.subject: William Theodore de Bary
relations.evidence: He entered Columbia University in 1937, and began studying Chinese the following year as a sophomore. After graduating with his Bachelor of Arts in 1941

relations.subject: William Theodore de Bary
relations.evidence: After graduating with his Bachelor of Arts in 1941, de Bary began graduate study in Chinese at Harvard University, but the following year he was recruited by the U.S. Navy

relations.subject: William Theodore de Bary
relations.evidence: In 1947, de Bary left the military and returned to Columbia for graduate study in Chinese. He received an MA in 1948 followed by a PhD in 1953

relations.subject: William Theodore de Bary
relations.evidence: became a professor afterward... rarely missing a Columbia Lions football game since he began teaching at the university in 1953... continued teaching until the end of the spring semester in 2017

relations.subject: William Theodore de Bary
relations.role: chair of the Department of East Asian Languages and Cultures
relations.evidence: From 1960 to 1966 he served as the chair of the Department of East Asian Languages and Cultures.

relations.subject: William Theodore de Bary
relations.evidence: He served as president of the Association for Asian Studies from 1969 to 1970.

relations.subject: William Theodore de Bary
relations.evidence: He served as Columbia University's provost from 1971 to 1978.

relations.subject: William Theodore de Bary
relations.evidence: De Bary founded the Heyman Center for the Humanities in 1976 and served as its director.
